evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down to 15 ppm, and it has stayed at about 4-7 ppm since.
Thermocouple followed the ramp setpoint to within about 0.5 °C.
Growth overshoot peaked at 760.2 °C and is settling, now 752.0 °C.
Heater power dropped from about 81% to about 40% at the switch from ramp to hold; this fits holding temperature.
Pressure steady at about 3.02 Torr and argon at 100 sccm.

args.missing_evidence: Reference values from normal runs for heater power during growth, to confirm about 40% is typical at 750 °C; later, characterization of the sample.
